What is black box insurance?

Black box insurance – also called telematics – is a type of car insurance where a small device is fitted in your car which measures how well and when you drive.

This means if you’re a safe driver, we’ll reward you with discounted insurance at renewal. It’s that easy.

text.text:
Our black box product is called LittleBox, but we actually offer three different types of LittleBox insurance.

We decide which type of LittleBox you'll get based on a few risk factors, such as the type of vehicle you drive or how long you've held your license. You can't choose which type of black box you get.

title.title: Is black box insurance for me?

text.text:
The telematics technology monitors how and when you drive along with lots of other risk factors to help calculate your driving score. Get a good driving score and you could get a cheaper insurance price at renewal.

You can drive anytime you like with LittleBox, but late-night driving (10pm-4am) will reduce your overall driving score. So, if you need to drive your car overnight, it may not be the best option for you.

It's important to remember that if you're driving extremely unsafely and consistently have a poor score, we could cancel your policy.

Theft tracking isn’t available on LittleBox Plug&Drive or LittleBox Pod, but let us know anyway and we’ll see what we can do.

item_0.name: Faq List Item
item_0.question: Are there any eligibility criteria for having a LittleBox?
item_0.answer:
LittleBox can be great for any safe driver looking to save money on their car insurance, there are just a few things you need to make sure suit you:

  • Your car needs to be worth at least £250
  • You'll need to drive at least 1,000 miles annually
  • Your car must have been manufactured in the last 15 years

item_1.name: Faq List Item
item_1.question: Can I drive my car before LittleBox is installed?
item_1.answer: Yes, you can drive as soon as your cover starts.

item_2.name: Faq List Item
item_2.question: Does LittleBox know where I am?
item_2.answer: Yes, LittleBox does send location information but we also look at how well you drive in order to offer you the best discount possible. We take a positive approach to your car insurance and encourage our customers to enjoy driving.

item_3.name: Faq List Item
item_3.question: How big is LittleBox?
item_3.answer: Our units are about the same size as a modern smart phone and are fitted out of sight in your car.

item_4.name: Faq List Item
item_4.question: How much does it cost to have LittleBox installed?
item_4.answer: There is no additional charge for the first installation.

item_5.name: Faq List Item
item_5.question: Do you share the information with any third parties?
item_5.answer: We only share the information with those companies required to provide the services under the policy, such as the telematics LittleBox service provider. Information isn't sold to or shared with anyone else.

item_6.name: Faq List Item
item_6.question: What if my LittleBox Pod is causing issues?
item_6.answer:
We’re sorry our device is causing problems.

Read our LittleBox Pod FAQs for more information.

item_7.name: Faq List Item
item_7.question: Is there a restriction on how many miles I can drive?
item_7.answer: During your quote just let us know how many miles you will cover over the year, and your premium will automatically include these. If during the year you need to travel further you will need to inform us, so we can increase your mileage to ensure you remain covered. Minimum mileage restriction applies (1,000 miles).

item_8.name: Faq List Item
item_8.question: How does LittleBox get installed, do I have to go somewhere?
item_8.answer: We will contact you regarding the installation of your LittleBox. This can be completed at a destination of your choice.

item_9.name: Faq List Item
item_9.question: Who do I contact if I need to re arrange the installation date?
item_9.answer: You will be provided with a number for our installation team and you will be able to re-arrange.

item_10.name: Faq List Item
item_10.question: Will I have a curfew with the policy?
item_10.answer: No, you can drive at any time of the day or night with no curfew – however frequently driving at risky times, between 10pm and 4am, will reduce your driving score.

item_11.name: Faq List Item
item_11.question: Will I have to pay anything if I do not renew my policy at the end of the first year?
item_11.answer: No. If you do not renew your policy there will be no additional charges. You will only have to pay the cancellation fee if the policy is cancelled before renewal.

item_12.name: Faq List Item
item_12.question: How do you know who was driving?
item_12.answer: We do not ask you to tell us who is driving the insured vehicle at any particular time. Your driving score will be calculated on overall use of the car, so you will need to make all named drivers aware that they can influence your driving score.

item_13.name: Faq List Item
item_13.question: Where is the box fitted and will it damage my car?
item_13.answer:
LittleBox hard install device is fitted at no extra cost to you, out of sight behind your dashboard. It's fitted by a trained technician and won't affect the vehicle's warranty.

You'll be contacted by our installation team to book an appointment with the engineer. They come out to you and the fitting only takes around 40 minutes.

If you have a LittleBox Plug and Drive device, this just needs to be plugged into the 12V power supply or cigarette lighter – this is something you can do at home.

If you have a LittleBox Pod, simply download the Admiral app, follow the in-app instructions and attach the device to your windscreen.

item_14.name: Faq List Item
item_14.question: Will you cancel my cover if I drive badly?
item_14.answer:
We use the information from the LittleBox device to assess the overall vehicle use and we’ll send regular feedback updates that will inform you if you driving score is good, average or poor.

LittleBox is all about rewarding safe drivers, however, if you are scoring poorly, the policy will be at risk of being revoked following a 7-day cancellation notice.

item_0.name: Accordion Item
item_0.text:
The clever little box that lowers the cost of car insurance

LittleBox is great for lots of people, and if you’re facing high insurance prices you could get a discount by having one of our clever little boxes active in your car.

The technology in our box looks at how you drive – if you drive safely, you could be rewarded with a lower price. But if you do lots of journeys throughout the day or you regularly drive at night, LittleBox may not work for you.

If you feel you're being punished for other people's bad driving, and particularly if you're a new driver or young driver then LittleBox could be for you.

Want to know what our customers think? Take a look at our LittleBox reviews.

Isn't it like having 'Big Brother' in my car?

No, we aren’t like 'Big Brother'. While the unit does collect your location data, we only use it for what we need to; this helps us to create your personalised driving score.

And great news - if the LittleBox is active and your car’s stolen, we’ll be able to help track its location.
